info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Tracks-v5-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery Track API allows users to retrieve tracking information for food delivery services. It provides detailed insights into the current status and location of deliveries, ensuring both customers and businesses can monitor progress in real time. Typical consumers include delivery personnel, customer service teams, and end users seeking updates on their orders. By facilitating easy access to tracking information, this API enhances the overall delivery experience and operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of a delivery.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to track the status of a specific delivery by providing the necessary tracking information. Users can retrieve real-time updates on delivery progress, ensuring they are well-informed about their package's journey.

200.description: Successfully retrieved tracking information for the delivery.
